# provider's). One condition a line, tab-separated: the document, a phrase it must contain (a regular expression,
# matched with the document's whitespace folded), a file in this folder, and text that file contains (a leading !:
# must not contain; \n and \t as escapes). Lines with the same document and phrase are one promise: all must hold.
# Promises whose check reads shared code too stay in tests/test_doc_claims.py.
